name: Waves-TS-TW
title: Waves
description: Hundreds of thin pale lines hang across a near-black stage and sway in soft waves, bunching into ribbons with dark gaps. Dragging the pointer pulls nearby strands and they spring back.
use: A dark section wants dense texture and gentle motion that fills the whole area.
avoid: Thousands of moving lines cost frames on weak devices and the texture fights small text.
a11y: A canvas backdrop with nothing to label; endless swaying ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage is filled edge to edge with masses of thin pale lines hanging vertically. The strands bunch into ribbons that bend into deep S-curves, leaving darker gaps where they pull apart.
behaves: The whole curtain sways without rest as drifting noise pushes each line, so bundles bunch and spread. The pointer drags nearby strands along and they settle back when it moves on.
customise: Line and background colour, speeds, amplitudes, point gaps, friction, tension and cursor reach are props; the cursor dot is drawn in source.
weight: moderate: Thousands of points run Perlin motion and cursor springs on a 2D canvas every frame.
